'''Barab II''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Barab (star)/Legends|Barab]] in the [[Barab system/Legends|Barab system]],<ref name="WB" /><ref name="GW" /> located in the [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Barab II was a [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] rock without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="WB" /><ref name="GW" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Barab system/Legends|Barab system]] were designed for the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'';<ref name="GW" /> however, an excerpt from the sourcebook was published as a promotional preview on the official [[Wizards of the Coast]] website, [[Wizards.com]], a couple of months before the book's release.<ref name="WB" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Barab star system in grid square U-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
